scope: Reader-visible life-status observations for tracked characters and a selected expanded cast of recurring crawlers and NPCs. This is not an exhaustive list of every named death. Introductions use neutral metadata. A reported death is labeled as such in its summary and deathEvidence field; presumed-dead is reserved for an unresolved disappearance described as fatal. Temporary reanimation and copied bodies do not reverse confirmed death. Absence of a death event does not establish survival.
coverageNotes: Eva dies in the Book 5 epilogue, which is absent from the numbered-chapter corpus. Her event uses the later explicit confirmation in Book 6 Chapter 19 and must not be labeled as the time of death.
Bomo is killed but is explicitly expected to regenerate; this audit does not treat that as a confirmed permanent death.
Signet is reported to have sacrificed her life after disappearing into the Nothing. Her status is presumed-dead rather than an independently confirmed permanent death.
